usage: Bot users should not be org owners
name: Bot users should not be org owners
description: Organization or first-level group owners/admins should not be bots.
detailedDescription: An organization or first-level group admin/owner has the authority to create, edit, delete repositories and manage permissions and access to repositories. A compromise of an admin/owner account can be devastating as a result. Given that no real user is behind a bot, a compromise of a bot may go undetected for a large period of time. Therefore, in order to reduce the attack surface it is recommended to revoke the owner permissions from bot users.
